whyItMatters: Invoke-Expression(payload) evaluates strings as powershell code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace Invoke-Expression(payload) with direct cmdlets with parameters so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Invoke-Expression(payload) call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Invoke-Expression(payload) reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
